name: RenderAnimatedOpacity
coverage: Opacity values per 16 ms tick checked by implicit__opacity__opacity, the retarget scenarios and the reduced-motion scenario. Not checked: alwaysIncludeSemantics (semantics is not in the frame recorder; implicit-004). Paint is recorded only as opacity.

name: RenderAnimatedOpacityMixin
coverage: Read against AnimatedOpacity (implicit_animations.rs:1079-1126) and the opacity descriptor (tree/descriptors.rs:1279-1295). The opacity value path is covered by the RenderAnimatedOpacity row. Semantics gate at zero opacity is absent in Incular (implicit-004).

name: RenderSliverAnimatedOpacity
coverage: Checked by implicit__sliver_opacity__opacity: the opacity trajectory starts one 16 ms frame late (first divergence frame 4). The endpoint and later frames converge.

name: AnimatedAlign
coverage: Physical alignment and widthFactor/heightFactor checked by implicit__align__alignment_and_factors. Not checked: directional AlignmentGeometry input (no Incular API; implicit-003).

name: AnimatedContainer
coverage: implicit__container__fields checks constraints, margin, padding, alignment, transform, transformAlignment and background color. Not checked: border and border-radius paint, foregroundDecoration and shadows (outside the frame recorder). Directional geometry inputs unavailable (implicit-003). Duration, curve and retarget behavior are shared with the ImplicitlyAnimatedWidget rows.

name: AnimatedDefaultTextStyle
coverage: Font-size and color animation checked by implicit__default_text_style__text_style: width matches; line-box height differs by 1 px on five frames (implicit-002). Paragraph options textAlign, softWrap, overflow, maxLines, textWidthBasis and textHeightBehavior are absent (implicit-006).

name: AnimatedFractionallySizedBox
coverage: widthFactor/heightFactor and alignment checked by implicit__fractional_sized_box__factors. Directional alignment input unavailable (implicit-003).

name: AnimatedOpacity
coverage: Opacity timing and retarget checked by implicit__opacity__opacity, implicit__retarget__current_value_and_on_end, implicit__retarget__new_duration_mid_flight, implicit__zero_duration__completion and implicit__disabled_animations__reduced_motion. A curve-only change mid-flight diverges: Flutter keeps the previous curve until the next target change (implicit-007). alwaysIncludeSemantics unavailable (implicit-004).

name: AnimatedPadding
coverage: Physical EdgeInsets checked by implicit__padding__edge_insets. Directional EdgeInsetsGeometry input unavailable (implicit-003).

name: AnimatedPhysicalModel
coverage: implicit__physical_model__color_elevation_radius checks geometry and fill color. Elevation, shadow, radius and clip are not in the recorder. BoxShape.circle is unsupported (implicit-005).

name: AnimatedPositioned
coverage: implicit__positioned__edges_and_size animates left, top, width and height between two sets of values and matches every frame.

name: AnimatedPositionedDirectional
coverage: implicit__positioned_directional__direction changes start from 12 to 44 while the ambient direction switches LTR to RTL during the tween; matches every frame.

name: AnimatedRotation
coverage: Turns and topRight alignment checked by implicit__rotation__turns_and_alignment. filterQuality paint quality not checked (shared transform gap, transitions-003).

name: AnimatedScale
coverage: Scale and bottomLeft alignment checked by implicit__scale__alignment. filterQuality paint quality not checked (transitions-003).

name: AnimatedSlide
coverage: implicit__slide__fractional_offset animates a fractional offset; geometry and transform match every frame.

name: ImplicitlyAnimatedWidget
coverage: Shared timing checked through concrete widgets: retarget uses the current value (implicit__retarget__current_value_and_on_end); a duration change applies at the next target change (implicit__retarget__new_duration_mid_flight); onEnd count (retarget and zero-duration scenarios); zero duration. Curve-only update diverges (implicit-007). Assertions on invalid input were not exercised.

name: ImplicitlyAnimatedWidgetState
coverage: didUpdateWidget equivalent (ImplicitState::update at implicit_animations.rs:170-198) checked by the retarget, new-duration, curve-only, zero-duration and reduced-motion scenarios. Flutter binds the curved animation only on target change (implicit-007); Incular reads the current curve on every build. Disposal is not frame-observable.

name: SliverAnimatedOpacity
coverage: implicit__sliver_opacity__opacity: endpoint matches, start is one frame late (implicit-001). alwaysIncludeSemantics unavailable (implicit-004).

name: TweenAnimationBuilder
coverage: implicit__tween_animation_builder__initial_and_retarget samples builder values, the initial begin and the retarget from the current value; onEnd count via implicit__retarget__current_value_and_on_end. Matches every frame.
